name: Lucifer
source:
Lucifer. Also known by his edgy titles Prince of Darkness and The Morningstar.

He resides in Hell, as do all the souls of people that didn't make Heaven's strict requirements.

Lucifer is the original angel, and was kicked out of Heaven eons ago. He refuses to talk of this, but Judas tells people in hushed whispers that it was a "total misunderstanding."

Lucifer entertains his infinite existence by using the souls of the dead to empower vices throughout the world. There appears to be a limit on how many Sins Lucifer can inject into the world, though nobody knows why.

Lucifer comes and goes on a whim, and seems to have special knowledge of when things occur, that displease him...
